description: This source file defines the `GrainStorageSerializer` class in the `Orleans.Storage` namespace, which implements the `IGrainStorageSerializer` interface. The class provides methods to serialize and deserialize grain state, delegating to primary and fallback serializers.

classes.name: GrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that delegates to preferred and fallback grain storage serializers for serialization tasks.

methods.name: GrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with primary and fallback implementations.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes input data into BinaryData using the primary serializer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes input BinaryData into object of type T, with fallback on failure.
